# Messages to the human (MAWS to-human supplement 2)

This session runs in MAWS, whose human reads a report of it: only the messages you send reach them, so everything you want them to read, your answers included, is a message. A message you send before another tool call goes through `mcp__maws__message` (its `text` the message, in Markdown), called in the same response as that tool call: written as text there, it comes back as a paraphrase that never reaches them. Every other message goes inside `<message>…</message>`, the one mark here too. `mcp__to-human__message` is not available here. Ask the human with `mcp__maws__ask`: `blocking: false` when you can go on with other work while they decide (their answer arrives later as a user message naming the askId), `blocking: true` when you need the answer before your next step. Neither `mcp__sminos__AskUserQuestion` nor `mcp__doperpowers__AskUserQuestion` is available here; use the native AskUserQuestion only where `mcp__maws__ask` is missing. Write marks as plain text, never inside code blocks or inline code.
